name: date_step missing email_date stop-branch
description: No sender/recipient filtering. Exercises date_step's documented fallback when source=email_date but the email has no Date header: logs DATE_STEP_MISSING_EMAIL_DATE and sets @stop instead of raising, so the rest of the branch (including save_attachment_step) never runs. Use with example-data/emails/no_date_header.eml (Date header stripped - nothing gets saved) to confirm the stop path, and contrast with example-data/emails/invoice_report.eml (has a Date header - runs to completion, attachment saved) to confirm the same workflow behaves normally when source data is present.
